body.x: ThisIsEngineering presented ‘Shift’, a drone can be operated single-handedly at 'CES 2018 Unveiled' in 7th of January in Las Vegas, United States.

Shift can perform a trI-axis motion and rotary motion with only the thumb and forefinger. In addition to being able to manipulate with one hand, the method of use is highly sophisticated and relaxing, leaving the user comfortable. Even novice can use easily. Currently, it is being promoted as a competitive product in the drone industry both at home and abroad.

CES, the world’s largest IT exhibition, is an exhibition of trends in the global consumer electronics industry, held annually in January by the American Consumer Technology Association (CTA). Aving News reported the most issues of CES, MWC, and IFA, which are world's top three tech exhibitions, during last 11 years. It is sending special reporters to CES for this year as well; reporting major issues in the world market and introduce Korea's major companies all over the world.
